title: Pre-Course Knowledge Survey
description: Ungraded. Answer from what you know now; you will see the same questions at the end of the course. One attempt.

questions.text: How familiar are you with the ADDIE model?
How confident are you writing a measurable learning objective?
How confident are you conducting a task analysis?
How confident are you designing an evaluation to determine whether instruction worked?
How confident are you applying multimedia and accessibility principles to online instruction?
In your own words, what is instructional design? Two or three sentences.
What do you most want to be able to do by the end of this course?
